name: September 12, 2026 Adjourned Meeting
minutes_text:
Minutes
  Lakewood City Council
  Adjourned Regular Meeting held
  September 12, 2026

MEETING WAS CALLED TO ORDER at 9:13 a.m. by Mayor Wood in the
Executive Board Room at the Civic Center, 5000 Clark Avenue, Lakewood,
California.

ROLL CALL: PRESENT: Mayor Jeff Wood
  Vice Mayor David Arellano
  Council Member Cassandra Chase
  Council Member Todd Rogers
  Council Member Rudy Villarreal

PUBLIC COMMENT ON ITEMS ON THE AGENDA – None

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS – None

LAKEWOOD CITY COUNCIL GOVERNANCE WORKSHOP

City Manager McCormack 1) introduced the item and explained the purpose of the
workshop; 2) introduced Consultant Michael Shellito of Shellito Training and
Consulting; and 3) along with Deputy City Manager Beltran and Consultant
Shellito, responded to Council Members’ questions.

For the record, discussion ensued relative to 1) pending issues, challenges, and
opportunities facing the City; 2) review of the City’s Vision, Mission, and Values
and their connection to the Strategic Plan; 3) building a strong City Council
organizational culture; and 4) issues requiring clarification.

For the record, there was no formal action taken on this item.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business to be brought before the City Council,
Mayor Wood adjourned the meeting at 2:01 p.m.

Respectfully submitted,

Dakota Wallace, CMC
City Clerk
